purpose: Behavioral regression test scenarios based on the client's explicit correction, not independent game data imports

definition.name: Shatter Storm / Breaking Wind
definition.default_description: Increases attack and defenses by 15%, unless otherwise stated

cases.example_raw_text: Makes all ally assaulters enter (20%) Shatter Storm state for 2 rounds.

note: The client confirmed that the per-use 20% overrides all affected stat increases. Do not treat this 20% as a proc chance, and do not modify the shared default.
